_note: Per-sentinel ultimate upgrade tracks (Upgrades -> Planet -> Ultimate), copied from PDTD's Ultimate Upgrades screen: four tracks per weapon — Charge Speed, Initial Energy, DMG Bonus, and a per-weapon count track — each bought a level at a time with Ultimate Alloy, and Unobtainium Alloy once past `unobtainium_from`. `per_level` is the stat gain per level; `cost` is the Ultimate Alloy price, which steps up by `cost_growth` each level. Effect keys are ModifierSet.ApplyEffect keys, scoped per weapon with the ow:<kind>: prefix; `ult_` stats are read by the ultimate system in OrbitalWeapons.cs.

tracks.name: Initial Energy
tracks.text: Start each run with the ultimate part-charged.
